Excuse my request.
I would like to request a piece of my original character.

▼Future in the "Creative A" folder at the link below.
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1GiOekd_LUN0GaAb0g8doOkRmOcTnTqwT?usp=sharing

▼Contents, etc.
We would like you to draw a picture with an anime-like pattern.
I would be happy if you draw a picture with a situation, etc., but I leave everything to you.

▼Others
Preferred file format
.psd file with non-character objects on separate layers.
Intended use
Icons and headers for SNS, creation of personal goods, reference material for requests to other people

We would appreciate it if you could leave any rough drafts or preliminary drawings that have been lost.

If you have any problems with the price or the content of the request, please resend it to us.
If it is too difficult, you can cancel the request.
Thank you very much.
